rule.name: CAW_constructCoreChartDataByLevelForSpecificGroup
rule.description: Constructs the necessary data format for the Core ASK Actual report charts by level
rule.definition: a!localVariables( local!coreAskDetails: #"_a-0000e69d-7e03-8000-9bf6-011c48011c48_3235974"( returnCDT: true, isCompleted: true, isActive: true, fiscalYear: ri!fiscalYear, dppGroupId: ri!selectedGroup, pagingInfo: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_pagingInfo"( startIndex: 1, batchSize: -1, sort: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_sortInfo"( field: "askDetailId" ) ) ), local!coreAskDetailLatestCompletedVersion: #"_a-0000e7f4-9a94-8000-9c23-011c48011c48_6753074"( asks: local!coreAskDetails ), #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: #"_a-0000e825-ace1-8000-9c24-011c48011c48_6911873", expression: a!localVariables( local!actualIdsForLevel: #"_a-0000e825-ace1-8000-9c24-011c48011c48_6911879"( level: fv!item ), local!plan: if( a!isNullOrEmpty(local!coreAskDetailLatestCompletedVersion), 0, sum( index( index(local!coreAskDetailLatestCompletedVersion, "headCountAmount", {}), wherecontains( local!actualIdsForLevel, index(local!coreAskDetailLatestCompletedVersion, "levelNeedId", {}) ) ) ) ), local!actual: if( a!isNullOrEmpty(ri!actualNominations), {}, index( ri!actualNominations, intersection( wherecontains( local!actualIdsForLevel, index(ri!actualNominations, "levelNeedId", {}) ), wherecontains( ri!selectedGroup, index(ri!actualNominations, "dppGroupId", {}) ) ) ) ), local!confirmed: length( index( local!actual, wherecontains( #"_a-0000e72d-09a6-8000-9c0e-011c48011c48_5076350", tointeger(index(local!actual, "statusId", {})) ) ) ), local!inProcess: length(local!actual) - local!confirmed, a!map( level: fv!item, plan: local!plan, confirmed: local!confirmed, inProcess: local!inProcess, open: if( local!plan - sum(local!confirmed, local!inProcess) < 0, 0, local!plan - sum(local!confirmed, local!inProcess) ) ) ) ) )
